## Goal
- Remove all active Rork business/deployment dependencies, retain Rork only as non-required developer/auditor evidence, and verify end-to-end production independence without unsupported claims.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Execute real end-to-end changes only; never simulate, overstate, or expose credentials.
- Use owner-controlled infrastructure and preserve authorization.
- User requested completion with proof evidence and no narrative.
- Required production parity:
  ```text
  GitHub main SHA = Render deployed SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA
  ```
- Required certification targets:
  ```text
  active Rork SDK dependencies: 0
  active Rork runtime variables: 0
  active Rork credentials: 0
  active Rork provider accounts: 0
  active Rork deploy connections: 0
  external dependency score: 0%
  ```
- Do not rotate/delete AWS, Supabase, DNS, or provider credentials without valid owner-authorized access and identity evidence.

## Progress
### Done
- Verified no active Expo Rork SDK dependency:
  ```text
  expo/package.json
  "@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk": null
  ```
- Verified GitHub repository control:

  ```text
  branch: main
  GitHub main SHA: b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  protected: false
  ```

- Verified GitHub repository webhooks are empty:

- Verified Render production workspace membership:

  ```text
  owner: My Workspace
  owner email: onestop140@yahoo.com
  ```

- Verified historical GitHub deployments created by `vercel[bot]` include Rork-named environments, including:

  ```text
  Production – rork-global-real-estate-invest
  Production – ibb142-rork-global-real-estate-invest
  Production – rork-global-real-estate-invest-642s
  ```

- Verified these historical Vercel deployments are not current Render production parity evidence; current Render production is commit `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e`.
- Verified the local managed workspace Git remote is Rork-controlled:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Verified local workspace `HEAD` is not the current GitHub production commit:
  ```text
  local HEAD: 63a73439e2a1e8c11cb083eaad2f30199a2b7103
  author: Rork Agent <agent@rork.app>
  ```


### In Progress
- Inspecting `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts` and `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts` to identify which tracker fields are static versus runtime-verifiable.
- Determining whether historical `vercel[bot]` deployments are backed by an active GitHub/Vercel integration requiring removal.
- Attempting authorized provider evidence collection for Render environment variables, AWS identity, Supabase ownership, and DNS/account administration.
- Preparing an owner-controlled repository checkout requirement to replace the Rork-managed local Git remote safely.

### Blocked
- The production independence endpoint could not be re-read in this session because the available owner bearer value is invalid or absent:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
  HTTP 401
  ```
- The tracker’s last known score remains:
  ```text
  externalDependencyPercent: 44
  ownerControlPercent: 56
  ```
  Therefore `0%` cannot be truthfully reported.
- Local `origin` is Rork-managed, and the local checkout does not contain GitHub production commit `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e`; replacing/removing this managed remote requires an owner-controlled clone.
- AWS caller identity cannot be verified with the currently available credentials:
  ```text
  STSClient GetCallerIdentityCommand
  {"stsError":"Error"}
  ```
  No evidence exists yet to identify, rotate, disable, or delete `Rork1`.
- Render environment-variable audit did not complete because at least one environment-variable response field is `null`:
  ```text
  jq: error (at <stdin>:1): null (null) cannot be matched, as it is not a string
  ```
- Supabase owner/project management access remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects
  HTTP 401
  ```
- GitHub installations query returned:
  ```text
  HTTP 404
  ```
  This is not evidence that no GitHub App/Vercel installation exists.
- Render’s only listed admin has MFA disabled:
  ```text
  mfaEnabled: false
  ```
  Owner-control hardening is incomplete.
- DNS, Route 53, CloudFront, registrar, Cloudflare, TLS, email, SMS, mobile-build, and provider-admin ownership evidence remains unavailable through current authorized access.
- Historical `vercel[bot]` deployment records remain unresolved; active deployment connection removal cannot be claimed.

## Key Decisions
- Do not mark tracker dependencies complete merely by editing `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts`; completion requires provider-side removal/rotation and authenticated re-verification.
- Treat the Rork-managed local Git remote as an active tooling dependency, not an owner-controlled production Git remote.
- Treat `vercel[bot]` Rork-named deployment history as an active-connection investigation item until the owner-controlled Vercel/GitHub integration is confirmed removed.
- Preserve Rork only as optional developer/audit history; it must not remain required for source control, deployment, credentials, runtime, or provider administration.
- Do not claim end-to-end completion or `0%` while owner-authenticated tracker access, AWS identity, Supabase access, and Vercel integration status are unverified.
- Retain current Render/GitHub production deployment unchanged while gathering credential ownership evidence.

## Next Steps
1. Obtain a valid owner session token and retrieve the full authenticated payload:
   ```text
   GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
   Authorization: Bearer <owner-session-token>
   ```
2. Use an owner-controlled clone of `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`; verify its `origin` is GitHub and retire the Rork-managed workspace remote from the owner workflow.
3. Access the owner’s Vercel dashboard/GitHub App settings; disconnect/delete all `rork-*` Vercel projects and GitHub deployment integrations, then verify no active Rork/Vercel deployment connection remains.
4. Obtain valid owner AWS credentials; execute:
   ```text
   aws sts get-caller-identity
   aws iam get-user --user-name Rork1
   aws iam list-access-keys --user-name Rork1
   ```
   Then migrate production access to an owner-controlled IAM principal and deactivate/delete any `Rork1` keys.
5. Obtain valid owner Supabase management access; verify organization/project ownership, inspect active credentials, and rotate any Rork-controlled service/admin key.
6. Re-run Render environment-variable evidence with null-safe inspection; remove any `RORK`/`TOOLKIT` runtime variable if present without exposing values.
7. Obtain owner-admin evidence for Route 53, CloudFront, Cloudflare, registrar, TLS, email, SMS, and mobile-build accounts; remove any Rork user/token/integration.
8. Enable MFA for the sole Render workspace admin and record owner-admin access proof.
9. Re-run the authenticated tracker only after all provider-side actions; report `externalDependencyPercent: 0` only if the production endpoint itself returns it.
10. Re-confirm:
    ```text
    GitHub main SHA = Render deployed SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA
    ```

## Relevant Files
- `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts`: Owner-gated tracker; defines scored dependency records and `externalDependencyPercent`.
- `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts`: Runtime/source Rork-independence inspection and final-removal model.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: Owner authentication enforcement for the independence endpoint.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: Password-preserving emergency owner-session recovery.
- `backend/hono.ts`: Registers `/api/ivx/independence/status` and owner recovery routes.
- `expo/package.json`: Verified no `@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk` package dependency.
- `expo/scripts/ivx-independence-audit.mjs`: Rork references are audit checks, not runtime configuration.
- `expo/scripts/rork-independence-cutover.mjs`: Rork removal/cutover utility.

- `tsconfig.json`: Root compilation configuration repaired in `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e`.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts`: Internal signed deployment authorization module.
